title: Exact inverse image transports the scalar Ext tensor pairing
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $X,Y$ schemes, and $t:Y\to X$. Use the scalar sheaf category, exact inverse image $T$, unit isomorphism $u:T\mathbf1_X\cong\mathbf1_Y$, and Yoneda tensor pairing $c$ of [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $\delta_{A,B}:T(A\otimes_k B)\to TA\otimes_k TB$ be the oplax tensor comparison obtained by taking the mate of the canonical lax tensor structure on sheaf direct image under its inverse-image adjunction. For arbitrary scalar sheaves $A,B$ on $X$, $A\prime,B\prime$ on $Y$, maps $\phi:TA\to A\prime$, $\psi:TB\to B\prime$, and $a\in\operatorname{Ext}^p(\mathbf1_X,A)$, $b\in\operatorname{Ext}^q(\mathbf1_X,B)$, one has $(u^{-1})^*T(c(a,b))\cdot\operatorname{Ext}^0(\delta_{A,B}\circ(\phi\otimes\psi))=c((u^{-1})^*T(a)\cdot\operatorname{Ext}^0(\phi),(u^{-1})^*T(b)\cdot\operatorname{Ext}^0(\psi))$, where the displayed composites are in diagrammatic order and have degree $p+q$. No scheme-module coefficient comparison or derived-cohomology map is involved.

source.place: Cohomology Tags 01FD, 07MB, 0FKV; generic exact inverse-image and tensor pairing argument. Official text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7 and the indicated tag pages.

proof.text: The inverse image of sheaves of k-vector spaces is exact and its canonical oplax tensor comparison is an isomorphism: on stalks it is the identity on the k-tensor of the two stalks. The unit comparison identifies the inverse image of the constant sheaf k with the constant sheaf k. This is the same comparison as scalarInverseUnitIso, since both are the adjoint of the constant section 1. Expand scalarExtCup as its two tensor-functor transports and Yoneda composition. Exact-functor transport preserves composition and degree-zero morphisms. The oplax tensor comparison intertwines inverse image followed by each tensor functor with the corresponding tensor functor followed by inverse image. Apply naturality of Ext transport under these comparison transformations. The oplax left-unitor identity identifies the initial degree-zero morphism, and associativity of Ext composition gives the equality before postcomposition by phi and psi. Naturality of tensoring under phi and psi moves these degree-zero morphisms to the two inputs. Equivalently, apply inverse image to the signed resolution tensor pairing of Tag 07MB and then the two coefficient morphisms; exactness and Tag 0FKV identify both augmentations. No signs change, since all comparison maps have degree zero. The same identities apply in degree zero, for zero sheaves and on empty schemes.
